name: app-canvas-studio
description: App Canvas Studio - low-code studio driven by metadata

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.security:sbom: pnpm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --lockfile-only --out sbom.cdx.json && node tools/ci-checks/src/bin.ts sbom-check sbom.cdx.json
scripts.verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm generate && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm depcruise && pnpm test && pnpm test:gates && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:gates-e2e && pnpm security
